## TEST-ONLY handoff · PR #46 final old-kicker assertion fix

**Unique current product/test SHA:** `2aaa478c8f1966e41b9372d9d989c383dbaa1972`. This PR #46 commit changes **only** `prototype/m1-lite/tests/e2e/ui-v3-integration.spec.cjs`; GitHub diff verified, JS syntax compile PASS. It now requires two-digit procurement stage numbering and the approved **“系统设置”** label for settings instead of obsolete `ADMIN`. It preserves all subsequent navigation, 3-viewport geometry and state assertions.

Prior **fbb98944** independent results are immutable: Python44 PASS, Node10 PASS, Chromium57 PASS/1 FAIL; last failure was the old ADMIN expectation after background #F6F8FB passed, with later assertions NOT REACHED. Independent buyer, S4, supplier export, tooltip 83, six-page screenshots and 1366×768 quote-first-row were PASS **only on that old SHA**. Original first assign-search timeout was NOT REPRODUCED, ROOT CAUSE UNKNOWN. Windows native 3 NOT TESTED.

**Execute now on exact new SHA, with fresh isolated synthetic SQLite/PDF:**
1. First run the original `UI V3 integration: theme, active navigation and responsive workspace` Playwright case and verify **every assertion after old line 76 actually executes**; do not treat a standalone kicker query as full PASS.
2. Run full original Python backend, Node business and Chromium E2E suites (no skip/retry/forced click/threshold weakening). Independently verify at least representative buyer navigation, status, tooltip safety, PDF/ZIP restore and 1366×768 quote-row scope on this same SHA; record any untested detail explicitly.
3. If `#runAssignSearch` initial actionability timeout recurs, preserve unmodified failure plus consecutive-frame geometry, computed style/animations, focus/hover/scroll, elementFromPoint/hit stack, screenshot and trace. If not, say NOT REPRODUCED; ROOT CAUSE UNKNOWN.
4. Append **new versioned evidence directory in this existing Draft PR #50**, with Chinese/English report, accurate SHA, raw logs/traces/cases, PASS/FAIL/NOT TESTED, and comment on PR #46. Leave old evidence unchanged. Windows native 3 remain NOT TESTED absent real Windows execution.

**TEST-ONLY restriction:** no product/test/CI changes by Codex, no Actions dispatch, no merges/closures, no main/M1 modifications. This task comment does **not** initiate execution. Do not carry old-SHA PASS into this new SHA.
